sequencing_rule: Start with the first feature where passes is false unless the founder explicitly overrides sequence.

features.title: Commercial V2 Documentation And Decision Lock
features.summary: Create the V2 decision pack, PRD, data model, pricing/entitlement model, retailer attribution plan, prompt architecture, latency/cost budget, and repository impact plan.
done_when: V2 docs exist under docs/Tracks/v2-commercial
homeowner AED 100 room unlock is specified
designer USD 99/month subscription is specified
retailer attribution model is specified
founder open questions are listed
features.notes: Approved by founder on 2026-05-04. No UI or schema implementation in this slice.

features.title: User Mode And Entitlement Schema
features.summary: Extend auth/domain data to distinguish homeowner, designer, subscription, room unlock, and entitlement states.
done_when: user profiles store intended mode
room unlock and subscription entitlement tables exist
server-side entitlement helpers exist
RLS/privacy posture is updated
migration verification succeeds
features.notes: Completed on 2026-05-04. Payment provider intentionally deferred to V2-005.

features.title: Role-Based Entry And Homeowner Guided Flow
features.summary: Build first-run role selection and the simplified homeowner room creation/onboarding path.
done_when: new users choose homeowner or designer mode
homeowner can create a room without client/project complexity
designer users are routed to the existing project workflow
UX follows locked design system
browser verification covers both paths
features.notes: Completed on 2026-05-04. Visual style preference capture remains V2-004.

features.title: Visual Style Quiz And Preference Capture
features.summary: Replace jargon-heavy style entry for homeowners with image-led style cards, color choices, mood choices, and plain-language preference capture.
done_when: style cards include image, title, and plain-language description
users can select multiple liked styles
users can mark styles/colors to avoid
preferences map into structured design brief data
designer mode can still use advanced notes
features.notes: Completed on 2026-05-04. Style card imagery uses editorial interior references; future production pass should replace with owned/licensed assets.

features.title: Billing Provider Integration
features.summary: Implement homeowner room unlock payment and designer subscription checkout.
done_when: homeowner can pay AED 100 for a room unlock
designer can subscribe at USD 99/month
webhook updates entitlements idempotently
failed/cancelled payment states are visible
billing secrets are server-only
features.notes: Completed with Stripe Checkout on 2026-05-08. Public deployed webhook still needs Stripe dashboard configuration for the Vercel domain.

features.title: Shopping Preview And Unlock UX
features.summary: Create locked shopping-list preview and paid unlock surfaces.
done_when: unpaid homeowners see a useful but gated shopping preview
paid homeowners see exact unlocked shopping links
designers with active subscription bypass homeowner room paywall
locked states clearly explain value
server-side checks prevent URL leakage
features.notes: Founder must approve exact SKU visibility before payment.

features.title: Retailer Partnership And Feed Model
features.summary: Add retailer partnership, campaign, feed, and code-pool data structures.
done_when: retailer partnerships can store data access route and commercial status
discount campaigns can be configured per retailer
code pools or auto-discount rules can be stored
feed ingestion records source and permission metadata
existing catalog adapters still work
features.notes: Build for retailer-provided feeds first, public extraction fallback second.

features.title: Tracked Retailer Redirects
features.summary: Replace direct product URLs in unlocked experiences with signed Ritzy redirect links.
done_when: unlocked product links use signed Ritzy redirect URLs
redirect endpoint validates entitlement
outbound click events are recorded
affiliate/campaign parameters are attached where configured
expired or unavailable products fail gracefully
features.notes: This is required before any retailer-facing attribution promise.

features.title: Discount Code Assignment
features.summary: Assign eligible discount codes or auto-discount links to paid room unlocks and subscribed designer rooms.
done_when: discount eligibility is retailer-specific
unique codes can be assigned from a code pool
codes can expire or be marked consumed
UI shows discount terms clearly
no discount is shown when campaign coverage is absent
features.notes: Avoid global public codes unless a retailer explicitly accepts leakage.

features.title: Retailer Attribution Reporting
features.summary: Create internal reporting exports for retailer clicks, unlocks, codes, and imported conversions.
done_when: admins can export retailer click report
admins can export discount-code assignment report
conversion imports can be stored
reports reconcile clicks to products and rooms
privacy-sensitive user data is minimized
features.notes: Self-serve retailer dashboard is deferred unless explicitly approved.

features.title: Commercial UX End-To-End QA
features.summary: Run homeowner, designer, paywall, redirect, and discount QA passes.
done_when: homeowner free-to-paid room journey is browser-verified
designer subscription journey is browser-verified
locked shopping links cannot be accessed without entitlement
retailer redirects record attribution
design guardian and UX guardian passes are documented
features.notes: Must include mobile and desktop screenshots.
